summary: This clinical trial tested the drug AZD6234 in adults who have type 2 diabetes and are overweight or have obesity. Participants were already taking a steady dose of another type of diabetes and weight-loss medicine called a GLP-1 receptor agonist. The study compared the test drug against a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks just like the real medicine. AstraZeneca sponsored this Phase 2 study, which involved 69 participants and is now completed.
